# no-duplicate-feature-names

Disallow duplicate Feature names across the lint target set.

| Category | Recommended | Safe autofix | Default options |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| correctness | yes | no | none |

Finds case-insensitive duplicate Feature names across linted files.

## Configuration

```json
{ "rules": { "no-duplicate-feature-names": "error" } }
```
